source_documents.role: The quality program requires comparable audit metrics and declining owner-scoped static debt but does not define the command or corpus.
The English community section lists GitHub Discussions, the plugin topic, and Discord.
The Chinese community section lists GitHub Discussions, the plugin topic, and WeCom/WeChat QR material instead of Discord.

findings.summary: No dedicated audit-metric command or machine-readable corpus/exclusion contract was found; exploratory grep counts are sensitive to file families and token context.
findings.limitations: The exploratory counts are diagnostic only and must not become acceptance values until the canonical schema and corpus are implemented.

findings.summary: The English page advertises Discord while the Chinese page advertises WeCom/WeChat QR material; shared Discussions and plugin-topic links are aligned.
findings.limitations: The difference may be an intentional locale-owned channel addition or semantic drift; an agent must not choose between those policies.

metric_schema.recording_rule: Emit JSON to a retained artifact and include exact commit, environment, glob, exclusion, and counting semantics.

include: tracked source files under packages/, apps/, scripts/, python/, native/, benchmarks/
exclude: snapshots unless the metric names snapshots
corpus_policy.requirement: The command must print the resolved file list or a digest of it so later counts are comparable.

channel_decision_options: Treat Discord and WeCom/WeChat as intentional locale-owned additions and document the exception.
Require both locales to advertise the same community channels and remove or add the differing channel.
Use a shared canonical channel list with explicit locale-specific annotations.
implementation_scope: Add the metric command and focused positive/invalid corpus fixtures.
Record the maintainer channel decision before changing README content.
Add a documentation parity check that distinguishes approved locale additions from accidental omissions.

commands: scan for existing metric commands and metric contracts
run exploratory source counts for deprecated, suppression, TODO, any, and skip patterns
extract and compare the English and Chinese community sections

decision.result: AAA-018:A01 PASS — metric and documentation-parity design specified; locale-channel policy remains maintainer-owned
decision.diagnosis: The repository has comparable-metric intent but no canonical metric owner or corpus, and the English/Chinese community pages differ in one channel family. The implementation must wait for the explicit channel policy decision.
decision.next_action: Obtain the locale-channel decision, then implement the metric schema and documentation-parity command under the approved policy.
